### Lassen County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/lassen-county)
County seat: Susanville. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Lassen County runs from sagebrush flats around Honey Lake and the Nevada line up to pine forest near Westwood and Eagle Lake, and north into big ranch valleys. Sales are scattered over long distances, so I match homes by setting before miles.
ZIP codes: 96109, 96114, 96117, 96121, 96123, 96128, 96130, 96132, 96136, 96137
Lassen County homes sit in high, open country: older houses and ranch homes in Susanville, ranchettes across the Honey Lake Valley near Johnstonville, Janesville and Standish, cabins near Eagle Lake, and mill-era houses at Westwood. Susanville winters are long, and sales are few. I hear from people settling a Lassen County estate, dividing property in a divorce, or filing a bankruptcy that needs a value soon.
- Honey Lake Valley ranchettes often come with a well, septic, a hay barn, corrals and irrigated pasture. I value the home on its acreage against other rural sales in the valley.
- Lassen snow, cold and wind wear on roofs, decks and siding. I look closely at the roof, the heat source and the foundation in your photos and adjust for the wear I see.
- Cabins near Eagle Lake and around Westwood may be seasonal, with plowing and winter access to consider. I note the road, the water source and whether the place works year-round.
Photos: Photograph the roof, the wood stove or furnace, the well and pressure tank, and the barn, corrals or shop. Show the pasture and mountain view, and in snow, the driveway and the roof under it.
Q: My bankruptcy attorney needs a value for my house in Susanville. Can you help?
A: Yes. Attorneys usually want the value as of the filing date, so I appraise it as of that date with Susanville and Lassen County sales from then. I note its condition from your photos and give an honest number, not one aimed at a result.
Q: Can you do a Lassen County appraisal in winter when the yard is under snow?
A: Yes. Snow doesn't hold me up, since I work from your photos, the county record and past sales. Take clear photos inside and out as well as you can, and send any summer pictures of the yard and roof. I'll note what the snow hid.

### Los Angeles County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/los-angeles-county)
County seat: Los Angeles. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Valuing homes across Los Angeles County means switching markets all day: beach towns, canyon hillsides, postwar tracts in the San Fernando and San Gabriel valleys, foothill neighborhoods under the San Gabriel Mountains and desert subdivisions along the Antelope Valley Freeway. I compare each home only with sales from its own pocket.
ZIP codes: 287 ZIP codes
Los Angeles County runs from the Malibu coast to the Antelope Valley desert, and I appraise homes in every part of it, from beach cottages to Valley ranch houses to hillside homes above the city. The need usually comes right after a parent dies, a marriage ends or heirs need a buyout. I work from your photos and the public record, so nobody waits on a site visit.
- Much of the county's foothill and canyon land is in a high fire hazard zone, and since the January 2025 fires, buyers study brush, roofs and vents. I note defensible space and fire-hardening in your photos.
- In unincorporated places like Altadena, East Los Angeles and Hacienda Heights, the county handles permits. When a room, pool or back unit looks newer than the record, I check the county's permit history.
- On Catalina Island, Avalon homes are small, close together and rarely for sale, so I may reach further back in time for island sales and explain each adjustment rather than borrow mainland ones.
Photos: In the foothills and canyons, show the slope behind the house, the cleared space around it, the roof, vents and gutters. In the flats and near the coast, show the street, the parking, any view and any back unit.
Q: How do I appeal my property taxes in Los Angeles County if values dropped?
A: You file with the county's Assessment Appeals Board, and the 2026 regular filing window was set to close November 30. My appraisal as of January 1, the date your assessment is measured on, backs your case with nearby sales, though the board makes the final call.
Q: Can you appraise our Altadena house as of the day before the Eaton fire?
A: Yes. A retrospective appraisal values the home as it stood before the fire, using sales from that time plus whatever records and photos survive, even old listing pictures. People use them for insurance claims and casualty-loss questions for their CPA. I can also value the Altadena lot as it stands today.

### Madera County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/madera-county)
County seat: Madera. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Madera County runs from the valley floor at Chowchilla up through foothill oak country toward Yosemite. Values shift with elevation, water and access, so I weigh each sale by how much it shares those things with your house.
ZIP codes: 93601, 93604, 93610, 93614, 93636, 93637, 93638, 93643, 93644, 93645, 93653, 93669
Madera County climbs from flat farmland around Madera and Chowchilla through the oak and granite foothills of Coarsegold and Oakhurst to the cabins at Bass Lake, with new master-planned neighborhoods off Highway 41 near the river. Whether it's a foothill place after a death or a valley tract house in a divorce, I start as soon as your photos arrive.
- Foothill homes around Coarsegold, Ahwahnee and North Fork usually run on a well, septic and propane, with steep drives and granite. I check access, usable land and fire clearance, and compare with foothill sales.
- Bass Lake cabins have their own small market. I look at lake access, views, parking and winter roads, and I separate year-round homes from seasonal cabins when choosing comparables.
- In Riverstone and Tesoro Viejo along Highway 41, builder sales and resales sit side by side. I weigh both and note any special taxes and HOA dues in each community.
Photos: Show the driveway from the road, the slope and granite around the house, the cleared ground, the well and propane tank, and any deck view. For a valley home, the yard, AC unit and garage are enough outside.
Q: My sister wants to buy me out of Dad's Madera Ranchos house, where to start?
A: With one independent appraisal both of you can read. I value the house and its land from your photos and the records, show the sales I compared and explain each adjustment. I don't work for either of you, so the number isn't anyone's opening offer.
Q: Does Prop 19 let us keep Mom's low property taxes on her Bass Lake cabin?
A: Generally not, if the cabin wasn't her primary home. Prop 19's parent-child exclusion mainly covers a family home a child moves into, plus family farms, so a second home is usually reassessed. That makes its market value on the transfer date the key number, and I appraise to that date.

### Marin County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/marin-county)
County seat: San Rafael. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Marin County splits into distinct pieces: Southern Marin's hills, the Ross Valley towns, the San Rafael and Novato flats, and rural West Marin. I keep comparables inside your piece, since a few miles here can change the market.
ZIP codes: 20 ZIP codes
Marin County homes climb the hillsides under Mount Tamalpais, fill the flats and tracts of San Rafael and Novato, and spread along the ranch roads and beach towns of West Marin. I value them after a parent dies, during a divorce and for Prop 19 transfers, often when an heir has to decide quickly whether to move into the family house or sell it.
- On steep Mill Valley and Sausalito lots, I note the climb from the street, whether parking is on the lot, and how much land is usable, since buyers here pay for each.
- Eichlers in Terra Linda, Lucas Valley and Marinwood have their own following, so I compare them with other Eichlers and note how much of the original design survives.
- In West Marin and on the ridges I check septic and well records and fire-hazard maps, and near Stinson Beach or Santa Venetia I check flood exposure.
Photos: Photograph the stairs or driveway up from the street, the deck and what you see from it, and the hillside behind the house, including the cleared defensible space if you back up to open space.
Q: If I move into my parents' Marin house, how does Prop 19 change our property taxes?
A: In general, if you make it your primary home you keep part of your parents' tax break, but market value beyond a set limit is added to the assessment. So the value on the transfer date matters, and that's the number I provide. Your tax advisor applies the rules.
Q: Can you appraise Dad's Novato house as of the day he died last year?
A: Yes. A date-of-death appraisal uses Novato sales that closed around that date, not today's market. If you've already cleared out or repainted, older listing photos or family snapshots help me see the house as it was.

### Mariposa County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/mariposa-county)
County seat: Mariposa. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Mariposa County ranges from grassy ranch land in the west to pine ridges along Highway 140 and the enclaves near Yosemite's south entrance. I keep Mariposa comparables at the same elevation and access before reaching farther.
ZIP codes: 93623, 95306, 95311, 95325, 95338, 95345, 95389
Mariposa County homes are spread out: older houses in the town of Mariposa, ranch homes on oak land around Catheys Valley and Hornitos, cabins in the pines at Midpines and Fish Camp, and rentals near Yosemite. Nobody wants to wait for an appraiser to drive out, so I work from your photos when an estate, a divorce or a buyout needs a number now.
- Near Fish Camp and Yosemite West, many homes earn income as vacation rentals. I value them by sales of similar homes, leave the furnishings out, and note the rental setup buyers expect.
- Around Midpines, where the Oak Fire burned, I look at cleared space, damaged trees, rebuilt homes and the roads in, and your photos show me the parcel as it is now.
- Wells, septic, propane and long dirt drives are normal here. I check the record for permits on additions and outbuildings, since rural homes in these hills often grew in stages.
Photos: Photograph the cleared space around the house, the roof, the propane tank, the well and pump house, the drive in, and the view toward the ridges. For a rental cabin, show every bedroom and bath.
Q: Our house in Mariposa needs a new roof; should we fix it before you appraise?
A: You don't have to. I appraise the house as it is on the date you choose, worn roof and pine-needle gutters included, and describe the repair need. For an estate or divorce in Mariposa, the as-is value is usually what's needed.
Q: My brother wants to buy me out of our cabin near Yosemite. Where do we start?
A: Start with a single appraisal that both of you trust. I value the cabin from photos and recent sales between Fish Camp and Midpines, and the report goes to both of you at once. A neutral number makes the buyout talk much easier.

### Mendocino County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/mendocino-county)
County seat: Ukiah. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Mendocino County runs from foggy headlands and redwood ridges on the coast, over the hills to the Ukiah and Anderson valleys, and north to Laytonville and Covelo. Coast, valley and backcountry homes each draw their own buyers, so I don't mix their sales.
ZIP codes: 26 ZIP codes
Mendocino County gives me two markets: board-and-batten cottages and older homes on the coast in Fort Bragg, Mendocino, Albion, Elk and Gualala, and ranch homes and vineyard country inland around Ukiah, Willits, Hopland and Anderson Valley. The need usually comes from settling a trust or selling an older house as is, and the next step waits on the value.
- Coast homes from Fort Bragg to Gualala live with salt air, fog and bluff erosion. I look hard at siding, decks and windows, and at how close the house sits to the bluff edge.
- In the hills around Comptche, Albion Ridge, Laytonville and Covelo, homes often run on wells, springs, solar and generators. I note the water and power setup and compare with other Mendocino backcountry sales.
- Water can run short on the coast, and some homes around Mendocino village rely on wells or hauled water. I ask about the well, the storage tanks and any limits on use.
Photos: Photograph the view from the main rooms, the siding and deck on the ocean side, the well, tanks and pump house, and any solar or generator. Inland, show the vineyard or valley view.
Q: Should I get an appraisal before selling my mom's Fort Bragg house as is?
A: It helps. An as-is appraisal tells you what the Fort Bragg house is worth in its current condition, before cleanup or repairs, so you can weigh offers against repair costs. I compare it with nearby homes in similar shape, so show me the worn spots.
Q: We're settling a family trust in Mendocino County. Do we need a date-of-death appraisal?
A: For a Mendocino County trust, your tax advisor will likely ask for one, since the date-of-death value usually sets the heirs' new tax basis. The same report helps when you divide the trust or price a sale. I appraise as of that date with coast, Ukiah or Willits sales.

### Merced County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/merced-county)
County seat: Merced. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Merced County is mostly flat, but its markets still differ: Highway 99 towns, west-side communities near San Luis Reservoir and rural parcels with wells. I match each home with sales from its own corner of the county.
ZIP codes: 18 ZIP codes
Merced County is almond, dairy and sweet potato country, with Merced, Atwater and Livingston along Highway 99 and Los Banos and Gustine on the west side toward Pacheco Pass. I appraise older homes in town, newer subdivisions at the edges and farmhouses out in the orchards. When a parent dies or a marriage ends, the house or the farm parcel is usually the biggest question, and I answer it from your photos.
- North Merced, out toward the UC campus, has many of the newer tracts, while central Merced and Atwater have older streets with big trees. I keep comparisons within the same era, since the two sell differently.
- Los Banos grew fast in the 2000s, so whole neighborhoods share a builder and floor plans. I compare within the same tracts and note solar, pools and changes from the original plan.
- Parts of Merced along Bear Creek, and Planada, flooded in January 2023. For homes there, I check flood maps and ask what was damaged and how it was repaired.
Photos: Photograph the backyard fence line so I can see what's behind it: an orchard, a canal, a dairy or another tract. If the house took on water in a past storm, show the repaired walls and floors.
Q: Can you appraise my Merced house as of a date back in 2021?
A: Yes. A retrospective appraisal values the house as it was on a past date, using sales from that time. I'll ask what has changed since, like a new roof, an addition or flood repairs, and describe the house as it stood then.
Q: Do I need an appraisal of our house in Atwater before filing bankruptcy?
A: Your bankruptcy attorney decides, but many want a current value for the schedules and to weigh the homestead exemption. I give a plain, supported value of the house as it is today, condition and all. I don't advise on the bankruptcy itself.

### Modoc County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/modoc-county)
County seat: Alturas. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Modoc County is high, dry and wide open, from the Warner Mountains and Surprise Valley to Goose Lake and the juniper and sagebrush country around Alturas and Adin. I compare homes by setting and distance from town, reaching far when I must.
ZIP codes: 96006, 96015, 96101, 96104, 96108, 96112, 96115
Modoc County is about as remote as California gets, and the homes match: older houses in Alturas, ranch homes and farmhouses in Surprise Valley around Cedarville and Lake City, and places near Adin, Goose Lake and Davis Creek. Sales are few and far between. When a ranch home passes to the next generation or siblings need to sort out who keeps it, I can value it from your photos.
- Many homes here come with hay ground, corrals, shops and long gravel drives. I value the house and a reasonable homesite, and tell you when the ranch itself needs a ranch appraiser.
- Modoc winters are hard on older homes. I check the heat source, whether propane, wood or electric, plus the windows and roof, all from your photos.
- Surprise Valley sits across the Warner Mountains from Alturas, and its homes trade in their own market. I compare valley homes with each other first and adjust for the drive.
Photos: Photograph each room, then the furnace or wood stove, the propane tank, the well and the roof. Outside, show the barn, corrals and shop, the pasture, and the view toward the Warner Mountains.
Q: How can you appraise a house in Modoc County when hardly anything sells?
A: I use what does sell, even if it closed a while back or sits across the county, and adjust each sale for time, size, condition and acreage. Alturas and Surprise Valley sales carry the most weight, and the report shows each step.
Q: My sister wants to buy me out of our parents' ranch house near Cedarville. What's fair?
A: An appraisal gives you and your sister one value from someone with no stake in the ranch house. I appraise the house and homesite as of the date you choose, using Surprise Valley and other Modoc County sales. What you do with the number is up to you two.

### Mono County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/mono-county)
County seat: Bridgeport. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: September 15. Mono County spans Mammoth's ski condos and the June Lake Loop, ranch land in the Antelope Valley and the high desert around Benton. I treat the resort towns and the rest of the county as separate markets with their own comparables.
ZIP codes: 93512, 93517, 93546, 96107, 96133
Mono County homes line Highway 395: ski condos in Mammoth Lakes, cabins around June Lake and Crowley Lake, and older houses in Bridgeport, Lee Vining and the Antelope Valley. I read HOA papers as closely as photos here, and I'm usually called when a parent's condo passes to the kids or a divorce decides who keeps the ski place.
- In Mammoth Lakes, two condos in one complex can differ a lot: ski access, building, view, remodel and whether nightly rentals are allowed. I compare within the complex first.
- Snow shapes value here: covered or heated parking, roofs that shed well, and how far you carry skis and groceries from the car. I note each from your photos.
- Outside Mammoth, sales are few. In Bridgeport, Walker and Coleville I lean on older sales and nearby towns, and I adjust for winter access, wells and lot size.
Photos: For a Mammoth condo, show the kitchen, baths, fireplace, the balcony view and the walk to the lifts or shuttle. For a June Lake cabin, photograph the roof, deck and parking after a snow.
Q: Do you appraise condos in Mammoth Lakes, and does the HOA matter?
A: Yes, and it matters a lot. Dues, reserves, approved assessments and rental rules all shape what buyers pay for a Mammoth condo. Send the HOA statement with your photos, and I'll compare your unit with sales in the same or similar complexes.
Q: Gifting our June Lake cabin to the kids. Do we need a Mono County appraisal?
A: For a gift tax return, the IRS generally expects a qualified appraisal of real estate; your tax preparer will tell you what's required. I value the cabin as of the gift date from June Lake and nearby mountain sales, and the report can go with the return.

### Monterey County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/monterey-county)
County seat: Salinas. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Monterey County runs from foggy Peninsula neighborhoods and the Big Sur coast to the long Salinas Valley and the ranch country around King City. A Pacific Grove cottage and a Greenfield ranch house share almost nothing, so I keep every comparison local.
ZIP codes: 24 ZIP codes
Monterey County takes in Pacific Grove's Victorians, Carmel's cottages, newer homes on old Fort Ord land in Seaside and Marina, Salinas Valley farm towns from Castroville to King City, and ranch land in Carmel Valley and toward Big Sur. When a long-held house passes to the next generation or a trust has to be settled, I can start from your photos.
- Carmel-by-the-Sea homes have no street numbers, so I identify yours by street, cross street and parcel number. On small lots with strict design rules, small differences in setting carry real weight.
- On the Monterey Peninsula, water limits shape what can be added to a house. I check whether extra baths or a guest unit were permitted, since unpermitted space is valued differently.
- Down the valley in Soledad, Gonzales, Greenfield and King City, I compare within the valley, never with the coast. Homes on acreage in Prunedale or Corral de Tierra get rural comparisons.
Photos: Near the coast, photograph the ocean or bay view honestly, from inside and from the deck, plus any rust or wood rot from salt air. Inland, show the land, the well and outbuildings. In Carmel, include the cross street.
Q: Can we keep Mom's low property tax on her Pacific Grove house under Prop 19?
A: Sometimes. Under Prop 19, a parent's tax base can carry over only when a child makes the home their primary residence, and only up to a limit tied to market value. That's why the value on the transfer date matters. I provide it; your tax adviser and the assessor apply the rule.
Q: Does an unpermitted granny unit count in a Monterey home appraisal?
A: It counts, but not like permitted space. I describe it, give it the value the market supports and say plainly that it lacks permits. On the Peninsula, water rules can make legalizing a unit harder, and buyers factor that in.

### Napa County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/napa-county)
County seat: Napa. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Napa County mixes a valley floor of vineyards, hillside parcels on both ridges, the city of Napa and the lake country to the east. I compare valley-floor homes with valley-floor sales, and Howell Mountain parcels with mountain parcels.
ZIP codes: 94503, 94508, 94515, 94558, 94559, 94567, 94574, 94576, 94599
Napa County runs from American Canyon and the city of Napa up the valley through Yountville, St. Helena and Calistoga, with Angwin and Pope Valley in the eastern hills. I value homes here after a death in the family, in divorces and for trusts, and many sit on rural parcels where vines, wells and fire history all shape the number.
- Sales are thin up valley in Yountville, St. Helena and Calistoga, so I reach further back in time and adjust for acreage, outbuildings and views rather than borrow city sales.
- Since the Atlas and Glass fires, I check fire-hazard maps, whether a home is a rebuild, and how much clearing surrounds it, because hillside buyers here look closely at all three.
- In the city of Napa, older streets around Fuller Park have Victorians and bungalows, and after the 2014 earthquake I ask whether chimneys and foundations were repaired or braced.
Photos: Photograph the view across the vines or the valley, the well and pump house, the septic area, and the cleared ground around the house. In town, show the chimney, the foundation and any original woodwork.
Q: Can you appraise our parents' place near St. Helena with a few acres of vines?
A: Yes, when the land is mainly a home site with some planted vines. I value the house, acreage, well and views against other rural Napa Valley sales. A commercial vineyard or a winery needs a specialist, and I'll say so up front.
Q: Can an appraisal lower my Napa County property tax if values dropped this year?
A: It can support a request. If your home would have sold for less than its assessed value on January 1, the assessor can lower it for that year, and my report shows sales from your part of the valley. Napa County's 2026 appeal deadline is November 30.

### Nevada County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/nevada-county)
County seat: Nevada City. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Nevada County divides between the oak and pine foothills around Penn Valley and Grass Valley and the mountain country of Truckee and Donner Summit. I never compare across the two halves; each gets its own sales and its own adjustments.
ZIP codes: 95945, 95946, 95949, 95959, 95960, 95975, 95977, 96161
Nevada County gives me two very different markets: the gold-rush towns of Grass Valley and Nevada City, with their Victorians and wooded acreage, and Truckee's mountain homes off Interstate 80. Either way, a trust that needs settling or a divorce in progress can't wait weeks for a site visit, so I work from your photos and the county record.
- West county homes often sit on wooded acreage with a well, septic and sometimes NID ditch water. I note which you have, since irrigation and usable pasture matter around Penn Valley and Rough and Ready.
- In Lake Wildwood and Lake of the Pines, the gate, the HOA and lake frontage drive value. I compare inside each community first and adjust for waterfront, golf-course lots and docks.
- Many Victorians in Nevada City and Grass Valley have been reworked several times. I look at foundations, old wiring and how additions tie in, and compare them with other older homes.
Photos: Show me any granny flat or second unit, the shop or barn, the wood stove, defensible space and the well. For a Truckee home, add the snow-load roof, the garage and the view toward Donner Lake.
Q: Does a granny unit on our Grass Valley acreage add value?
A: Usually, if it's permitted and livable. I look for western Nevada County sales with second units, then adjust for size, kitchen, separate entrance and septic capacity. An unpermitted conversion still gets described, but I value it carefully.
Q: Our parents' trust holds a house in Nevada City. Does the trustee need an appraisal?
A: Usually, yes. It documents the date-of-death value for the step-up in basis and gives everyone a fair figure whether the house is sold or kept. I value the Nevada City house as of the date of death.

### Orange County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/orange-county)
County seat: Santa Ana. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Across Orange County I move from beach towns and harbors to flat inland tracts, the San Joaquin Hills and the canyons under Saddleback. A sale a few miles away can belong to a different market, so I keep comparisons close.
ZIP codes: 89 ZIP codes
Orange County homes change every few miles. I value 1950s ranch tracts in the north county, beach cottages on the coast, and master-planned villages in Irvine and the south county. Most people who reach me need a number soon, after a parent dies, during a divorce, or when a property tax bill looks too high, and I work from your photos.
- In Ladera Ranch, Rancho Mission Viejo and other south county planned communities, I read the tax bill for Mello-Roos and note HOA dues, since buyers weigh those costs against the house.
- Canyon homes in Silverado, Modjeska and Trabuco Canyon carry brush, slope and access questions. I study your photos of the lot, the defensible space and the road in.
- In the north county's postwar tracts, many houses have grown with added rooms or a converted garage. I compare the county's recorded size with your photos and count additions carefully.
Photos: Shoot every room, the yard and the street. If you can see water, hills or a fairway, photograph it from inside. In older north county houses, show any room addition or converted garage.
Q: How do I appeal my property taxes in Orange County if values dropped?
A: Orange County's regular appeal window for 2026 was set to close November 30. I appraise your home as of January 1, the valuation date for that tax year. I can't promise a result, but you'll have a written value to back your appeal.
Q: We live out of state, how do we get mom's house appraised?
A: You don't need to fly in. A neighbor or an agent can walk through with a phone and send me photos of each room. I add public records and nearby sales and value the house as of the date she died.

### Placer County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/placer-county)
County seat: Auburn. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: September 15. Placer County covers valley suburbs, Gold Country foothills and Sierra snow country, from farmland near Sheridan to the shore of Lake Tahoe. I compare homes within their own band: valley with valley, foothills with foothills, mountains with mountains.
ZIP codes: 18 ZIP codes
Placer County runs uphill from Granite Bay and Loomis through Auburn and Colfax to the north shore of Lake Tahoe. Outside Roseville, Rocklin and Lincoln, I see horse property, old fruit-ranch houses, foothill homes on acreage and Tahoe cabins. People reach me after a parent dies or a divorce starts, when a number is needed before the next step.
- Around Loomis, Penryn and Newcastle, many homes sit on old fruit-ranch land with barns, packing sheds and canal water. I note the outbuildings and irrigation, since buyers here weigh them.
- Granite Bay homes vary widely by lot size, closeness to Folsom Lake and gated setting. I keep comparables within Granite Bay rather than borrowing from the Roseville tracts next door.
- From Colfax up to Alta and Dutch Flat, snow, steep lots and cabins take over. At Tahoe City and Kings Beach, I compare lake-area homes with each other and note distance to the shore.
Photos: Photograph barns, shops, fencing and pasture on acreage, the pool and yard in Granite Bay, and the roof, deck and parking on a Tahoe or Colfax-area cabin. Include the canyon or lake view if you have one.
Q: My mother left me her Auburn house; what value do I use for taxes?
A: For an inherited Auburn house, the step-up in basis generally uses market value on the date of death; your tax preparer can confirm how it applies. I appraise the house as of that date from Placer sales around that time, and the report goes in your records.
Q: Should I get an appraisal before listing a house in Placer County?
A: It helps when the house is hard to price: acreage in Loomis, a cabin above Colfax, an older Auburn home with years of add-ons. My appraisal shows what the market supports before you set a list price.

### Plumas County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/plumas-county)
County seat: Quincy. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. From Lake Almanor down the Feather River canyon to Graeagle, Portola and the edge of Sierra Valley, Plumas County is a string of separate valleys. Each trades mostly within itself, so I start local and widen only when needed.
ZIP codes: 95923, 95934, 95947, 95971, 95981, 95983, 96020, 96103, 96105, 96122, 96129
Plumas County homes sit in mountain valleys: around Lake Almanor near Chester, in Quincy's American Valley, along the golf courses of Graeagle, and in Portola on the Middle Fork of the Feather River. Heirs often live hours away, so I value the family place without anyone making the trip and give everyone one clear number to decide on.
- Around Lake Almanor I separate lakefront, lake-view and interior lots, and check whether a home sits inside Lake Almanor Country Club, with its own dues and rules, or on the Peninsula or east shore.
- In Greenville and Indian Valley, the Dixie Fire reshaped the market. I look at what's been rebuilt, what's still a cleared lot, and which pre-fire and post-fire sales truly compare.
- Graeagle has old mill-town cottages near the pond, golf homes at Whitehawk Ranch and Plumas Pines, and cabins up the Gold Lake road. I give each its own comparables.
Photos: Show me the roof, the wood or pellet stove, the deck and its view, and cleared space around the house. On Lake Almanor, photograph the shoreline, the dock and the path down.
Q: We all live out of state. Can you appraise Mom's cabin near Quincy?
A: Yes. A neighbor, a caretaker or one of you on a summer visit can take the photos, and I handle the rest from county records and Plumas sales. Nobody has to drive up the Feather River canyon just to learn what the cabin is worth.
Q: Can you value our Greenville property in Plumas County as of before the Dixie Fire?
A: I can. A value as of a past date, such as the day before the fire, is a retrospective appraisal. I rely on the county record, your older photos and sales from that time in Indian Valley. Your tax advisor or insurer decides how it's used.

### Riverside County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/riverside-county)
County seat: Riverside. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Riverside County reaches from the Santa Ana River near Orange County, over the San Jacinto Mountains, to the Coachella Valley and the Colorado River at Blythe. I value homes in valleys, desert, foothills and snow country, each against sales from its own market.
ZIP codes: 68 ZIP codes
Riverside County runs from citrus-era bungalows in Riverside and horse lots in Norco to stucco tracts in Moreno Valley, vineyard acreage outside Temecula, Coachella Valley country clubs and cabins in Idyllwild. People call me after a parent dies, during a divorce or when one sibling wants to buy out the rest, and each of those comes with a deadline.
- I keep each comparison inside its own market: a Palm Desert condo, a Corona tract home and an Anza ranch don't compete for the same buyers.
- Many newer tracts carry Mello-Roos or other special taxes. I read the tax bill and compare with sales carrying similar charges, since buyers weigh the full yearly cost.
- From the hills above Corona to the pines around Idyllwild, I look at brush, slope and roofing in your photos and check the fire hazard maps.
Photos: Shoot every room and the yard, then whatever sets the place apart: the pool in the desert, the view from a foothill lot, stalls and an arena in Norco, or the woodstove and deck in Idyllwild.
Q: Is there a deadline to appeal property taxes in Riverside County this year?
A: Yes. For 2026, the county's deadline to file a regular assessment appeal is November 30. What I add is an independent appraisal as of the date your appeal concerns, so the appeals board sees a supported value rather than a guess.
Q: Do I need my own appraisal if mom's house is going through probate?
A: A California probate uses a court-appointed referee to set the inventory value. Executors often want their own appraisal anyway, to price the house or plan a buyout among siblings. Whether it's in Banning or Blythe, I can value it as of the date of death.

### Sacramento County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/sacramento-county)
County seat: Sacramento. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Sacramento County goes from Delta farmland and river towns through the capital's older neighborhoods and postwar suburbs to the foothill edge at Folsom and Rancho Murieta. I match each home to sales in its own setting, whether Delta river town, suburb or rural acreage.
ZIP codes: 53 ZIP codes
Sacramento County is more than the capital. It's ranch homes under big oaks in Carmichael and Fair Oaks, acreage in Wilton and Rio Linda, newer tracts in Rancho Cordova, and levee-side homes in Walnut Grove and Isleton. After a death in the family or during a divorce, someone usually needs a fair number soon, and that's where I come in.
- In Carmichael, Fair Oaks and Arden-Arcade, lot size, mature trees and remodel level vary house to house. I pay close attention to how each 1950s or 1960s ranch home has been updated.
- Out in Wilton, Herald and Rio Linda, homes often come with acreage, wells, horse setups and shops. I compare them with other rural parcels, not nearby tract homes.
- Rancho Cordova mixes older ranch homes with much newer subdivisions on its edges. I keep comparables to the same era and builder, since buyers treat the two very differently.
Photos: Photograph the kitchen and baths as they are, the backyard and pool, the roof, the HVAC unit and any additions. On acreage, show the shop, barns and well; along the river, the levee side.
Q: Do I need an appraisal of my Carmichael house for a bankruptcy filing?
A: Your bankruptcy attorney decides, and many ask for one showing the Carmichael home's value on the filing date. I appraise it as of that date from your photos and nearby sales, in a report the court and trustee can follow.
Q: Does living behind a levee in the Sacramento County Delta change our home's value?
A: It can. Flood zone status, insurance cost and levee condition all shape what buyers pay around Walnut Grove and Isleton. I check the flood map for your parcel, compare with other river-area sales, and note raised floors or flood vents in your photos.

### San Benito County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/san-benito-county)
County seat: Hollister. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. San Benito County packs suburban Hollister, the mission town of San Juan Bautista and wide ranch and vineyard land in the hills to the south. Lot size, water and distance from town weigh heavily here, and I measure each from local sales.
ZIP codes: 95023, 95043, 95045, 95075
San Benito County is Hollister, San Juan Bautista and a lot of open ranch land, with Tres Pinos and Paicines down Highway 25. Hollister's homes run from older streets off San Benito Street downtown to newer subdivisions at the edges of town and the golf homes at Ridgemark. When a Hollister house or a ranch has to be valued for a divorce or an estate, I can do it from your photos.
- Hollister sits on an active fault, and in older parts of town you can see creep in curbs, sidewalks and walls. I look for cracks and settling in your photos and note what's been repaired.
- Ridgemark, the gated golf community south of town, has its own dues and its own sales, so I compare inside it first. Outside the gates, lot size and views of the hills carry more weight.
- San Juan Bautista is a small mission town where few homes sell in a year. I widen the search carefully and explain why each comparable from Hollister or the nearby hills fits.
Photos: Photograph cracks in the slab, driveway or walls, and the curb out front, since fault creep shows up there. On ranch land, take the well, fencing, barn and a wide shot of the land.
Q: How much is our Hollister house worth for our divorce settlement?
A: A neutral appraisal answers that. I value the house as of the date your attorneys pick, using Hollister sales close in time and style, and I don't lean toward either spouse. Your photos and the public record are enough for me to start.
Q: How quickly can I get a home appraisal in San Benito County?
A: I email the report within 24 hours of payment and your photos, any day of the week. There's no site visit to schedule in Hollister or out at the ranch, which is usually what slows appraisals down.

### San Bernardino County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/san-bernardino-county)
County seat: San Bernardino. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. San Bernardino County runs from valley suburbs below the mountains to snow country around Big Bear, the high desert past Victorville and Barstow, and the Colorado River at Needles. I never value a home in one of those markets with sales from another.
ZIP codes: 76 ZIP codes
San Bernardino County is huge, and its homes go from older bungalows and ranch tracts in San Bernardino, Highland and Colton to mountain cabins in Big Bear, Lake Arrowhead and Crestline, and desert homes in Yucca Valley, Joshua Tree and Barstow. I value houses in all three settings for estates, divorces, Prop 19 transfers and bail property bonds, usually within days.
- In Big Bear, Lake Arrowhead and Crestline, I look at steep lots, decks, stairs, snow and the drive in. A lake-view cabin and one in the trees can be far apart in value.
- Around Yucca Valley, Joshua Tree, Landers and Twentynine Palms, homes range from old homestead cabins to newer builds on wide lots. I check water, septic and road access, and distance from Highway 62.
- In older parts of San Bernardino, Highland and Colton, many postwar homes have add-ons. I check the record against your photos, so an unpermitted room isn't counted like original living space.
Photos: In the mountains, photograph the deck, view, stairs, driveway and roof. In the desert, show the land, the water tank or well, and the road in. In the valley, show the yard and any added rooms.
Q: Do I need an appraisal for a Prop 19 transfer in San Bernardino County?
A: Under Prop 19, a San Bernardino County home's market value on the transfer date can matter, so I appraise it as of that date with sales from the same corner of the county, mountain, desert or valley. The assessor and your tax advisor decide how the rule applies to your family.
Q: Can I use my house in Highland for a bail property bond?
A: A court that takes your Highland house as a property bond will want to know what it's worth. I compare it with Highland and San Bernardino sales. The court decides whether to accept the bond; my part is an honest value.

### San Diego County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/san-diego-county)
County seat: San Diego. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Valuing homes across San Diego County means changing gears every few miles. An ocean-view house in La Jolla, a canyon-rim bungalow in Kensington, a horse property in Ramona and a cabin in Julian each need sales from their own pocket, and that's how I choose them.
ZIP codes: 96 ZIP codes
San Diego County runs from beach towns on the coast to avocado groves, mountain cabins and desert homes in Borrego Springs, and I value homes in all of it from your photos, public records and nearby sales. Most people here call me after a parent dies, during a divorce, or when a sibling buyout can't move until the house has a number.
- Around Alpine, Jamul and Valley Center, I look at brush clearance, roof material and how the house sits against the hillside, since fire history and insurance weigh on buyers there.
- On acreage near Fallbrook and Ramona, I check for a well and septic, how much of the land is usable, and whether groves, barns or a second home add value.
- Along the coast from Oceanside to Imperial Beach, I separate a real ocean view from a glimpse between rooftops, and I check permits on older beach houses that grew over time.
Photos: Photograph every room and the front, then add what your part of the county calls for: cleared brush on a backcountry lot, the well and septic area on acreage, or the view from the deck near the coast.
Q: Can an appraisal help me appeal my property taxes in San Diego County?
A: It can support one. For a decline-in-value appeal I value the home as of January 1, using sales from your own corner of the county. In 2026 the San Diego County deadline for a regular appeal was set at November 30; the appeals board makes the final call.
Q: How do we get Mom's San Diego County house appraised from out of state?
A: Nobody has to fly in. A neighbor, a property manager or a local agent can walk through with a phone and send me photos of every room. I pull the county records and nearby sales, whether the house is in Oceanside or El Cajon, and email the report to all of you.

### San Francisco (https://www.cwift.net/areas/san-francisco)
County seat: San Francisco. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: September 15. San Francisco is one county on the tip of the peninsula, but fog, hills and building type split it into many small markets. I compare a Bernal Heights cottage with Bernal cottages, not with Sunset row houses.
ZIP codes: 30 ZIP codes
San Francisco packs Victorian flats, Sunset row houses, Marina-style homes, TICs and downtown condos into one small city, and no two blocks trade quite alike. I value homes here after a death in the family, in divorces, for trusts and for buyouts between co-owners, often when a probate attorney or TIC partner needs a figure before the next step.
- Microclimate matters here: the same house trades differently in the fog of the Outer Richmond than in sunny Noe Valley, so I keep comparables within the same neighborhood and weather belt.
- Many San Francisco houses sit wall to wall on narrow lots, so light, a usable yard and a garage that fits a modern car matter, and I compare those features directly.
- Parts of the Marina and the eastern flats sit on fill, and the 1989 quake showed it, so I check seismic hazard maps and note any foundation or retrofit work on record.
Photos: Photograph every level, including the garage and anything built behind it, plus the view from the front and back windows. For a condo, add the building entry, the parking space and the common deck or garden.
Q: How do you appraise a TIC unit in San Francisco when it isn't a condo?
A: I compare it first with other TIC sales, ideally in buildings with a similar number of owners and the same kind of financing, then look at nearby condos to see the gap. Send me your TIC agreement too.
Q: My mother's Noe Valley house is in probate, what do you need from me?
A: The date of death, the address, and photos of each room, the outside, the garage and the basement as they are now. If anything was remodeled or rented out after she died, tell me, because I value the house as it was on that date.

### San Joaquin County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/san-joaquin-county)
County seat: Stockton. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. San Joaquin County mixes Delta islands, Lodi wine country, almond towns along the Stanislaus River and commuter suburbs near the Altamont. A levee home and a Mountain House tract don't trade alike, so I keep each valuation in its own slice.
ZIP codes: 28 ZIP codes
San Joaquin County holds Lodi's vineyards and tree-lined streets, Ripon and Escalon among the almond orchards, newer planned communities in Lathrop and Mountain House, and Delta homes on levees and islands west of I-5. Whether it's a Delta place in an estate or a Lodi bungalow in a divorce, the house usually has to be valued first, and I work from your photos.
- Delta homes depend on the levee, the flood zone and the water. I check flood maps, then weigh the dock, slough frontage and how high the house sits, comparing with other waterfront sales.
- In Lodi, 1920s bungalows and postwar homes sit under big trees near downtown, while homes among the vineyards outside town carry acreage. I compare each with its own kind of sale.
- Mountain House and River Islands in Lathrop are planned communities with their own fees, special taxes and builder sales. I compare with resales in the same community first, then adjust for lot, plan and upgrades.
Photos: For a Delta or slough home, photograph the dock, the levee side and the view across the water. In Lodi or Ripon, show the yard, the trees and any outbuildings, plus every room.
Q: Mom's Lodi house is in a trust, do we need an appraisal before selling?
A: It's wise and common. A date-of-death appraisal documents the stepped-up basis for the heirs and shows the sale price was fair to everyone in the trust. I value the Lodi house as of the day your mother died, using sales from then. Your trust attorney or CPA can confirm the rest.
Q: Does being behind a levee lower home values in San Joaquin County?
A: It depends on the flood zone and what local buyers are used to. Much of the county sits behind levees, so I compare your house with sales that share its flood designation. Where zones differ, I measure the effect from the market rather than guess.

### San Luis Obispo County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/san-luis-obispo-county)
County seat: San Luis Obispo. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: September 15. San Luis Obispo County spans foggy coastal towns, the college town of San Luis Obispo, oak hills around Atascadero, hot vineyard country near Paso Robles and the open Carrizo Plain. I compare each house with sales from the same climate and terrain.
ZIP codes: 21 ZIP codes
San Luis Obispo County runs from beach cottages in Cayucos and Pismo Beach to Morro Bay hillsides, Cambria's pines, and the ranches and vineyards around Paso Robles, Templeton and Atascadero. Many have been owned for decades, so an estate, a trust or a Prop 19 transfer often turns on a careful value, and I prepare it from your photos.
- Water decides a lot here. Cambria has long limited new water connections, and rural Paso Robles homes rely on wells in a strained basin. I note the water source and any limits on building.
- Atascadero's original colony lots are often big and steep, with oaks, septic and long driveways. I look at usable land and access as closely as the house itself.
- Along the coast, a full ocean view, a peek view or no view can move value as much as size does. I judge it from your eye-level photos and compare with sales that have similar outlooks.
Photos: Take the view from each main window and the deck at standing height, without zoom. Show oaks near the house, the driveway grade and the septic or well area. Near the beach, include rust, dry rot and railings.
Q: Do I need an appraisal if my parents gift me their Cambria house?
A: Usually. A gift of real estate is generally reported at its fair market value on the date of the gift, and an appraisal from a certified appraiser supports that figure. The transfer may also raise Prop 19 questions. I supply the value; your CPA handles the filings.
Q: We live out of state, can you appraise Dad's San Luis Obispo County home?
A: Yes, without anyone flying out. Whoever has a key, a friend, a neighbor or the property manager, can take phone photos of each room, the views from the windows and the outside. I add the records and nearby sales, then email you the report.

### San Mateo County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/san-mateo-county)
County seat: Redwood City. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. San Mateo County is really three markets: the bayside cities along El Camino and Caltrain, the wooded ridges along Skyline, and the coast from Pacifica to Pescadero. I compare within the one your home is in.

San Mateo County runs from Daly City's Westlake tracts through the older Burlingame and San Carlos neighborhoods to Menlo Park, plus the coast. I value homes here after a parent dies, in divorces and for Prop 19 transfers, and on a house held for decades the gap between the tax bill and today's value can be wide.
- In Westlake and Serramonte the houses are close cousins, so I look hard at the extras: a finished room behind the garage, a remodeled kitchen, and an ocean view.
- On the coast I check bluff erosion in Pacifica, water and sewer service around Montara and El Granada, and coastal permits for additions, since each can limit a buyer's plans.
- Along Skyline, in Woodside and around La Honda, parcels are wooded and one of a kind, so I lean on access, usable land, fire clearing, and well and septic records more than square footage.
Photos: Photograph any ocean or bay view, the rooms below the main floor and the yard's slope. On the coast or up on Skyline, add the well, the septic area, the driveway and nearby trees.
Q: Can you tell me what my Half Moon Bay house was worth when my spouse died?
A: Yes. I value the house as of the date of death using coastside sales from around then, and describe it as it was. A surviving spouse often needs that number for the basis on community property, and your CPA decides how it applies.
Q: Should we fix up Mom's San Mateo County house before selling or sell it as is?
A: I can't make that call for you, but I can value it as is and, if you like, as if the planned work were done. Dated 1950s Peninsula houses often sell to buyers who plan to remodel anyway, and the two numbers show whether the work pays.

### Santa Barbara County (https://www.cwift.net/areas/santa-barbara-county)
County seat: Santa Barbara. 2026 regular assessment-appeal deadline: November 30. Across Santa Barbara County I value on both sides of the Santa Ynez Mountains: the coastal plain from Carpinteria to Goleta, the open hills of the Santa Ynez Valley, and the farm fields of the Santa Maria Valley. ZIP codes: 19 ZIP codes
Santa Barbara County homes range from Spanish-style houses and foothill estates on the South Coast to ranch properties in the Santa Ynez Valley and tract streets in Lompoc, Santa Maria and Orcutt. Many have been owned for decades on old tax bases, so I'm often valuing after a death, for a trust, a Prop 19 transfer or a divorce.
- For Santa Ynez Valley ranches near Solvang and Los Olivos, I look at acreage, wells, septic, fencing and barns, and compare with other rural sales, not town lots.
- In Lompoc, Santa Maria and Orcutt I sort the older central streets from the newer subdivisions, then compare remodel level and lot size inside each.
- On the South Coast I check fire and debris-flow maps for foothill and creek-side homes, especially around Montecito, and read your photos of the slope and drainage.

Q: Does Prop 19 change anything for our parents' house in Santa Barbara County?
A: It can. Since Prop 19, a child generally keeps a parent's tax base only on a family home they move into, and the home's market value on the transfer date matters. I can appraise it as of that date for your attorney or CPA.
Q: Can you appraise a Solvang house as of when dad died years ago?
A: Yes. I appraise as of past dates often. Santa Ynez Valley sales are fewer, so I may draw on Buellton, Santa Ynez or Los Olivos sales from that time. Old photos or a description of the house then help me set the condition.

- South County is its own market: around Morgan Hill, San Martin and Gilroy I see ranchettes with wells and horse setups, and I compare them with other acreage, not valley tracts.
- Valley-floor ranch houses have often been added onto over the decades, so I compare your photos with the county's recorded square footage and note rooms or second stories that never reached the record.

Q: Can an appraisal help me appeal my Santa Clara County assessment on a recent purchase?
